endorsements.name: Audrey François
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1402
endorsements.description: The Event Tickets and Registration plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized loss of data due to a missing capability check on the 'ajax_ticket_delete' function in all versions up to, and including, 5.19.1.1. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to delete arbitrary Attendee tickets.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)

endorsements.name: Audrey François
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-3404
endorsements.description: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the savePackage function in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.12. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php).
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)

endorsements.name: Audrey François
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-3453
endorsements.description: The Password Protected – Password Protect your WordPress Site, Pages, & WooCommerce Products – Restrict Content, Protect WooCommerce Category and more plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 2.7.7 via the 'password_protected_cookie' function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract sensitive data including all protected site content if the 'Use Transient' setting is enabled.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)

endorsements.name: Audrey François
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-5482
endorsements.description: The Sunshine Photo Cart: Free Client Photo Galleries for Photographers plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to privilege escalation via account takeover in all versions up to, and including, 3.4.11. This is due to the plugin not properly validating a user-supplied key. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to change arbitrary user's passwords through the password reset functionality, including administrators, and leverage that to reset the user's password and gain access to their account.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)
